remediation.name: checkout-worker
remediation.current_value: no env entries at all (pod shows "Environment:    <none>")
remediation.required_value: an AMQP_URL entry, e.g. env: [{name: AMQP_URL, value: "amqp://rabbitmq.payments.svc:5672/"}] (or a valueFrom pointing at a ConfigMap/Secret key that exists in the payments namespace)

arguments.root_cause_statement: The Deployment payments/checkout-worker ships a container command that refuses to start unless AMQP_URL is set, but its pod template defines no environment variables at all: spec.template.spec.containers[worker] has no env block, and the payments namespace contains no ConfigMap or Secret carrying that value (the only ConfigMap is kube-root-ca.crt, and there are no Secrets). Every pod the ReplicaSet creates therefore prints "FATAL: AMQP_URL not set" and exits 1 immediately, so the container is restarted into CrashLoopBackOff and the Deployment stays 0/1 Ready, which is what the workload availability monitor paged on. The fix is to add the AMQP_URL environment variable to the Deployment's pod template (either a literal value or a valueFrom reference to a ConfigMap/Secret key that actually exists in the namespace).
arguments.mechanism: The Deployment payments/checkout-worker has an empty environment in its pod template — spec.template.spec.containers[worker].env is absent — while the container's command requires AMQP_URL to be non-empty, so the worker container prints "FATAL: AMQP_URL not set" and exits with code 1 on every start; the kubelet restarts it repeatedly (5 restarts, waiting=CrashLoopBackOff) and the Deployment reports 0/1 Ready.

evidence.claim: The paged Deployment is 0/1 Ready and its only pod is crash-looping with an Error exit.
The worker container is in CrashLoopBackOff with repeated restarts.
The container itself reports the missing variable as the reason it exits.
The Deployment pod template defines no env for the worker container, though its command requires AMQP_URL.
The running pod confirms no environment variables were injected.
The container exits 1 each time and the kubelet backs off restarting it.
evidence.quote: Back-off restarting failed container worker in pod checkout-worker-66bfcdfc47-d9gdj_payments

ruled_out.alternative: A ConfigMap in the namespace holds AMQP_URL but the reference/key is wrong
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The only ConfigMap in the payments namespace is kube-root-ca.crt, whose sole key is ca.crt; no ConfigMap supplies AMQP_URL and the pod template references none.

ruled_out.alternative: A Secret supplies AMQP_URL and failed to mount or resolve
ruled_out.ruling_claim: There are no Secrets at all in the payments namespace, so no secret reference can be the missing link.
ruled_out.quote: 0 objects of kind secrets in namespace payments

ruled_out.alternative: Image pull failure or scheduling/node pressure keeping the pod down
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The pod was scheduled successfully and the image was present and started six times; the failure is the container exiting after start, not pull or placement.
ruled_out.quote: Normal   Started    84s (x6 over 4m27s)  kubelet            spec.containers{worker}: Container started
